claims.text: The Karnataka department's official annual report identifies HMA and SMA as marriage statutes administered by the Stamps and Registration Department and identifies Kaveri-2.0 as its latest online software.
claims.notes: Official report evidence is not a current case-level procedure.

claims.text: The current Revenue Department public page states that Sub-Registrars function as Marriage Officers under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 and the Special Marriage Act, 1954.
claims.notes: The page does not identify which Bengaluru office would handle a particular couple.

claims.text: HMA section 8 provides that a State Government may make rules for entering particulars of a Hindu marriage in a Hindu Marriage Register, may make entry compulsory in specified cases, and permits certified extracts on payment of the prescribed fee; omission of entry does not affect validity of the marriage.
claims.jurisdiction: India; Karnataka implementation by state rules
claims.notes: This is the statutory boundary only; it is not evidence of a completed registration or current Karnataka portal behavior.

claims.text: SMA sections 5–7 provide for written notice to the district Marriage Officer after at least one party has resided in that district for at least thirty days immediately before notice, entry/publication in the Marriage Notice Book and an objection route.
claims.jurisdiction: India; Karnataka administration by Marriage Officer/SRO
claims.notes: No Bengaluru Marriage Officer was selected and no notice or objection was filed.

claims.text: SMA sections 11–14 provide for parties and three witnesses to sign a declaration before the Marriage Officer, solemnization at the office or another permitted place, certificate entry signed by the parties and witnesses, and a new notice if solemnization does not occur within three months.
claims.jurisdiction: India; Karnataka administration by Marriage Officer/SRO
claims.notes: No declaration, witness appearance, solemnization, certificate or new-notice situation was attempted.

claims.text: SMA sections 15–16 separately provide for registration of a marriage celebrated in another form and prescribe a Marriage Officer procedure for that registration.
claims.jurisdiction: India; Karnataka administration by Marriage Officer/SRO
claims.notes: This separate statutory branch was not selected or tested in Kaveri.

claims.text: On 2026-08-31, the official Kaveri landing URL loaded a document titled “Kaveri Online Services” but exposed a blank visible page body after waiting; no unauthenticated HMA/SMA choice, login control, form, help text, error message or recovery link was visible.
claims.notes: The blank render is a visible interface failure, not proof that the service is permanently unavailable. No retry loop, login or bypass was attempted.

claims.text: The current Revenue Department public pages expose department descriptions, the Register of Marriages/SRO structure and the Sub-Registrar Marriage Officer role, but do not expose a current case-specific HMA or SMA application workflow in the unauthenticated pages reviewed.
claims.notes: Reviewed routes were the Revenue Department English home, Stamps & Registration page and Know-more page; no login or application action was taken.

claims.text: The Revenue Department home page publishes IPGRS and telephone 1902 as a general grievance route for concerns about Government of Karnataka service delivery.
claims.notes: Published recovery is general, not a verified Kaveri marriage-specific escalation or fix for the blank render.

claims.text: The current Bengaluru SRO/Marriage Officer, Kaveri HMA/SMA category availability, login/OTP boundary, application fields, document/original checklist, witness handling, fee, payment state, appointment availability, SMA notice publication/objection UI, processing time and certificate outcome remain Unknown after this public-only pass.
claims.notes: Unknown is precise to the unexposed operational boundary: no login, case data, payment, notice, objection, appointment, ceremony or certificate was attempted.
